columns.evidence_level_basis: direct whole-frame measurement of a retained source (L1)
columns.physical_meaning: 整图统计量（未标定、探测器坐标系）：全图像素灰度均值，整帧亮度水平代理
columns.formula: mean(g) over all pixels; g = 8-bit grayscale frame
columns.physics_basis: 探测器线性区内整帧亮度与入射辐射/样品散射强度单调相关；未标定，仅作相对漂移监测

columns.evidence_level_basis: direct whole-frame measurement of a retained source (L1)
columns.physical_meaning: 整图统计量（未标定、探测器坐标系）：全图像素灰度标准差（ddof=1），整帧对比度代理
columns.physics_basis: 灰度标准差正比于整帧空间对比度，对环带宽度、缺陷等结构变化敏感

columns.evidence_level_basis: direct whole-frame measurement of a retained source (L1)
columns.physical_meaning: 整图统计量（未标定、探测器坐标系）：64-bin 灰度直方图 Shannon 熵，整帧纹理/灰度分布复杂度代理
columns.formula: -sum(p_k*log2(p_k)); p_k = mass of the 64-bin histogram of g over [0,256)
columns.physics_basis: 直方图熵度量灰度分布分散度；结构增多（环变粗、缺陷出现）改变灰度质量分布从而改变熵

columns.evidence_level_basis: direct whole-frame measurement of a retained source (L1)
columns.physical_meaning: 整图统计量（未标定、探测器坐标系）：灰度>250 像素占比，饱和/过曝面积代理
columns.physics_basis: 探测器满阱/ADC 上限截断不可恢复，饱和占比升高指示过曝或光源异常

columns.evidence_level_basis: direct whole-frame measurement of a retained source (L1)
columns.physical_meaning: 整图统计量（未标定、探测器坐标系）：灰度<5 像素占比，欠曝/无信号面积代理
columns.physics_basis: 读出噪声底附近像元占比升高指示遮挡、快门或光路异常

columns.evidence_level_basis: direct whole-frame measurement of a retained source (L1)
columns.physical_meaning: 整图统计量（未标定、探测器坐标系）：4 邻域 Laplacian 响应方差，整帧清晰度（离焦/运动模糊）代理
columns.formula: var(L), L[i,j] = 4*g[i,j] - g[i-1,j] - g[i+1,j] - g[i,j-1] - g[i,j+1] (interior pixels)
columns.physics_basis: Laplacian 高通能量集中于边缘；离焦或运动模糊使高频能量下降、响应方差随之下降（MIA 2014 告诫：与相机漂移协变，解释需谨慎）
columns.tag_cn: 整图对焦清晰度（Laplacian 方差）

columns.evidence_level_basis: direct whole-frame measurement of a retained source (L1)
columns.physical_meaning: 成功解码且通过时间冲突检查的图像帧数（整源常量，非过程量）
columns.formula: count of rows in IMG-<SLUG>.csv (decoded, time-anchored frames)
columns.physics_basis: 数据完整性计数，非过程量

columns.physical_meaning: 快照二维场有限格元的算术均值（场整体幅值水平）
columns.formula: mean(v) over finite cells of the snapshot raster
columns.physics_basis: direct spatial statistic of the measured field (L1)
columns.evidence_level_basis: L1: deterministic statistic of retained source cell values; formula frozen in references/method_notes.md section 1
columns.method: map.snapshot_features (per-ts pivot to raster; median+3*rawMAD robust thresholds; numpy.diff gradient; no interpolation)

columns.physical_meaning: 快照二维场有限格元的第95百分位（高段幅值水平）
columns.formula: numpy.percentile(v, 95) linear interpolation over finite cells
columns.physics_basis: high-tail field level, robust to single-cell spikes
columns.evidence_level_basis: L1: deterministic statistic of retained source cell values; formula frozen in references/method_notes.md section 1
columns.method: map.snapshot_features (per-ts pivot to raster; median+3*rawMAD robust thresholds; numpy.diff gradient; no interpolation)

columns.physical_meaning: 过热像元占比：值大于快照中位数+3倍MAD的有限格元比例（局部过热面积指标）；几何解释依赖坐标系声明（geometric interpretation depends on the declared x/y coordinate frame）
columns.formula: count(v > median(v)+3*MAD(v)) / count(v); MAD = median(|v-median(v)|), raw (no 1.4826 factor)
columns.physics_basis: robust median+3MAD exceedance share; insensitive to non-Gaussian field tails (method_notes §1)
columns.evidence_level_basis: L1: deterministic statistic of retained source cell values; formula frozen in references/method_notes.md section 1
columns.method: map.snapshot_features (per-ts pivot to raster; median+3*rawMAD robust thresholds; numpy.diff gradient; no interpolation)

columns.physical_meaning: 过冷像元占比：值小于快照中位数-3倍MAD的有限格元比例（局部过冷面积指标）；几何解释依赖坐标系声明（geometric interpretation depends on the declared x/y coordinate frame）
columns.physics_basis: robust median-3MAD shortfall share (mirror of HOTAREA-P90)
columns.evidence_level_basis: L1: deterministic statistic of retained source cell values; formula frozen in references/method_notes.md section 1
columns.method: map.snapshot_features (per-ts pivot to raster; median+3*rawMAD robust thresholds; numpy.diff gradient; no interpolation)

columns.physical_meaning: 以值为权的场质心横坐标（场分布重心的水平位置）；几何解释依赖坐标系声明（geometric interpretation depends on the declared x/y coordinate frame）
columns.physics_basis: first spatial moment of the field (value centroid)
columns.evidence_level_basis: L1: deterministic statistic of retained source cell values; formula frozen in references/method_notes.md section 1
columns.method: map.snapshot_features (per-ts pivot to raster; median+3*rawMAD robust thresholds; numpy.diff gradient; no interpolation)

columns.physical_meaning: 以值为权的场质心纵坐标（场分布重心的纵向位置）；几何解释依赖坐标系声明（geometric interpretation depends on the declared x/y coordinate frame）
columns.physics_basis: first spatial moment of the field (value centroid)
columns.evidence_level_basis: L1: deterministic statistic of retained source cell values; formula frozen in references/method_notes.md section 1
columns.method: map.snapshot_features (per-ts pivot to raster; median+3*rawMAD robust thresholds; numpy.diff gradient; no interpolation)

columns.physical_meaning: 空间梯度幅值的第95百分位除以格间距（场内变化最剧烈部分的强度）
columns.formula: P95 over interior cells of hypot(diff(F,axis=1)/dx, diff(F,axis=0)/dy); dx,dy = median grid spacing
columns.physics_basis: first-order numpy-difference gradient; P95 keeps it robust to single-cell noise (method_notes §1)
columns.evidence_level_basis: L1: deterministic statistic of retained source cell values; formula frozen in references/method_notes.md section 1
columns.method: map.snapshot_features (per-ts pivot to raster; median+3*rawMAD robust thresholds; numpy.diff gradient; no interpolation)

columns.physical_meaning: 左右不对称度：左半列有限格均值减右半列有限格均值（场的水平偏置）；几何解释依赖坐标系声明（geometric interpretation depends on the declared x/y coordinate frame）
columns.formula: mean(left half of columns) - mean(right half of columns); middle column excluded when nx is odd
columns.physics_basis: zeroth-order left/right half-field comparison
columns.evidence_level_basis: L1: deterministic statistic of retained source cell values; formula frozen in references/method_notes.md section 1
columns.method: map.snapshot_features (per-ts pivot to raster; median+3*rawMAD robust thresholds; numpy.diff gradient; no interpolation)

columns.physical_meaning: 场最大有限值所在格的x坐标（峰值定位）；几何解释依赖坐标系声明（geometric interpretation depends on the declared x/y coordinate frame）
columns.formula: x coordinate of the maximum finite cell (row-major first on ties)
columns.physics_basis: argmax location of the measured field
columns.evidence_level_basis: L1: deterministic statistic of retained source cell values; formula frozen in references/method_notes.md section 1
columns.method: map.snapshot_features (per-ts pivot to raster; median+3*rawMAD robust thresholds; numpy.diff gradient; no interpolation)

columns.physical_meaning: 场最大有限值所在格的y坐标（峰值定位）；几何解释依赖坐标系声明（geometric interpretation depends on the declared x/y coordinate frame）
columns.formula: y coordinate of the maximum finite cell (row-major first on ties)
columns.physics_basis: argmax location of the measured field
columns.evidence_level_basis: L1: deterministic statistic of retained source cell values; formula frozen in references/method_notes.md section 1
columns.method: map.snapshot_features (per-ts pivot to raster; median+3*rawMAD robust thresholds; numpy.diff gradient; no interpolation)

columns.physical_meaning: 快照有限格元数（场完整性指标，缺失格恒为NaN，不做任何插值）
columns.physics_basis: completeness of the pivot grid; missing cells stay NaN and are never interpolated
columns.evidence_level_basis: L1: deterministic statistic of retained source cell values; formula frozen in references/method_notes.md section 1
columns.method: map.snapshot_features (per-ts pivot to raster; median+3*rawMAD robust thresholds; numpy.diff gradient; no interpolation)

columns.physical_meaning: 该快照全部有效位置测值的算术平均，代表剖面整体质量水平
columns.physics_basis: 同一横断面物理量采样的一阶矩；整体增厚/减薄直接反映在均值上
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 该快照有效位置测值的标准差（ddof=1），刻画剖面内不均匀度
columns.physics_basis: 同一横断面内的离散度；板形波动/厚度不均在标准差上直接显形
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 该快照有效位置测值的最小值
columns.physics_basis: 剖面最薄点（下限极值）
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 该快照有效位置测值的最大值
columns.physics_basis: 剖面最厚点（上限极值）
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 该快照有效位置测值的 5% 分位数（线性插值），稳健下包络
columns.physics_basis: 分位数比极值抗单点噪声，P05 稳健刻画剖面下包络水平
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 该快照有效位置测值的 50% 分位数（线性插值）
columns.physics_basis: 中位数是抗离群的整体水平读数，与均值互为对照
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 该快照有效位置测值的 95% 分位数（线性插值），稳健上包络
columns.physics_basis: 分位数比极值抗单点噪声，P95 稳健刻画剖面上包络水平
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 该快照有效位置测值最大值减最小值（剖面总幅值跨度）
columns.physics_basis: 极差是最直接的剖面总波动幅度度量（对单点噪声敏感，与 IQR 互为对照）
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 该快照 75% 分位减 25% 分位（剖面包络宽度，抗端点噪声）
columns.physics_basis: 四分位距是稳健散布度量，不受剖面两端单点异常影响
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 该快照有效值的中位绝对偏差（不带 1.4826 因子，稳健散布）
columns.physics_basis: MAD 对离群点稳健；口径按 method_notes 冻结为原始 MAD（不乘一致性因子）
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 该快照有限（可测）位置点数，剖面完整性指标
columns.physics_basis: 完整性决定形状类结论的可信边界：点数不足时形状特征按策略弃用
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 对有效位置做一次最小二乘拟合的斜率，按每 100 个位置归一（剖面整体倾斜度）
columns.physics_basis: 剖面整体倾斜对应横向厚度/浓度梯度；最小二乘斜率在均匀采样栅格上收敛于真实梯度
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 对有效位置做二次多项式最小二乘拟合的二次项系数（剖面凸度/板形弯曲）
columns.physics_basis: 二次项系数是剖面 Crown（凸度）的线性读数，板形/厚度横向弯曲的直接度量
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 剖面三等分后第 1 区（起始段，操作侧）的平均值
columns.physics_basis: 分区均值把连续剖面离散为工艺分区水平，便于分区归因（操作侧/中部/传动侧）
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 左侧 10% 边缘带均值减中心带均值（操作侧边缘增/减厚）
columns.physics_basis: 边缘增减厚（edge drop）是剖面最常见缺陷形态；外侧带-中心带对比是其直接度量
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 右侧 10% 边缘带均值减中心带均值（传动侧边缘增/减厚）
columns.physics_basis: 边缘增减厚（edge drop）是剖面最常见缺陷形态；外侧带-中心带对比是其直接度量
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 邻域偏差绝对值最大的位置点号（0 基；局部异常点的剖面内定位）
columns.formula: argmax_i |x[i] - mean(finite neighbours of i)| (0-based index)
columns.physics_basis: 局部异常点在邻域对比下最突出；取最大邻域偏差的位置作剖面内定位
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 对基线模板（in-control 逐位中位剖面）互相关估计的整位横向偏移（右移为正）
columns.formula: argmax_s corr(profile[overlap], baseline[overlap-shift]); integer s, overlap>=max(3,k/3)
columns.physics_basis: 横向配准漂移会被误读为形状变化（J. Process Control 2011 告诫）；先看 SHIFT 再解释 EDGE
columns.evidence_level_basis: deterministic statistic of a retained source snapshot (formula above); L1 per method_notes §1 evidence levelling

columns.physical_meaning: 时间锚定事件窗标志：t 时刻值=1 表示该源在 [t-3600s, t] 内记录过一次「清洗/清理」(cleaning)；窗口只向前过期（forward-only），由对齐层按 evt_window_s 实施，绝不向未来泄漏
columns.formula: 1 if any CLEANING annotation has event_ts in [t - evt_window_s, t] else 0; evt_window_s=3600
columns.physics_basis: 换辊/清洗/停机/报警等操作事件直接改变产线状态，是其后时序变化的候选原因；前向窗口保证因果方向（事件先于被解释的过程变化）
columns.evidence_level_basis: L2 用户文档：操作员备注/交接班/维护日志的文字记录，时间由记录者给出
columns._src_ts: = ts (an annotation row is stamped with its own event time)

columns.physical_meaning: 时间锚定事件窗标志：t 时刻值=1 表示该源在 [t-3600s, t] 内记录过一次「停机」(shutdown)；窗口只向前过期（forward-only），由对齐层按 evt_window_s 实施，绝不向未来泄漏
columns.formula: 1 if any STOP annotation has event_ts in [t - evt_window_s, t] else 0; evt_window_s=3600
columns.physics_basis: 换辊/清洗/停机/报警等操作事件直接改变产线状态，是其后时序变化的候选原因；前向窗口保证因果方向（事件先于被解释的过程变化）
columns.evidence_level_basis: L2 用户文档：操作员备注/交接班/维护日志的文字记录，时间由记录者给出
columns._src_ts: = ts (an annotation row is stamped with its own event time)

columns.physical_meaning: 时刻协变量：事件发生的当日至小数小时（0-24）。班次/时刻协变量——交接班整点混杂的显式对照项
columns.physics_basis: 交接班与昼夜班次惯例使事件时刻与工艺状态/人员行为系统相关，作为协变量显式对照交接班整点混杂
columns.evidence_level_basis: L2 用户文档：由事件记录的时间戳确定性换算（不引入外部信息）
columns._src_ts: = ts (covariate computed from the event's own timestamp)

columns.physics_basis: 交接班与昼夜班次惯例使事件时刻与工艺状态/人员行为系统相关，作为协变量显式对照交接班整点混杂
columns.evidence_level_basis: L2 用户文档：由事件记录的时间戳确定性换算（不引入外部信息）
